entries.rationale: The causal exponent clip was absent in the original Stage-0 assembly and allowed underflow to zero; CONF-05 now supplies the dtype-derived positive floor.
entries.title: causal exponent underflow was unbounded
entries.what_it_would_take: Keep the runtime clip fact and its metadata provenance enforced by the Phase-48 tests.

entries.rationale: The missing clip collapsed the causal front to the first collocation point; the strict-positive weight invariant is now exercised across CPU dtypes.
entries.title: causal front collapsed under zero weights
entries.what_it_would_take: Retain strict-positive causal weights and the dtype matrix regression coverage.

entries.rationale: The controller previously averaged nine residual components instead of assembling the locked one-third sum of three body norms; CONF-04 corrected the producer at the controller-to-catalog boundary.
entries.title: R-bar reduction used the component mean
entries.what_it_would_take: Keep the assembly-boundary interception test against the exact one-third reduction.

entries.rationale: The controller previously substituted an anchor-scaled energy floor and an additive numeric floor; CONF-02/03 now bind persisted epsilon-H metadata through the RunController seam.
entries.title: epsilon-H used the anchor energy instead of S-H
entries.what_it_would_take: Retain the run-level S_H metadata and exact epsilon-H assembly boundary proof.

entries.rationale: Stage-0 energy supervision was configured at a nonzero cap despite the locked PHYS-05 row; CONF-06 restores the exact zero schedule and keeps both shipped YAML entry points covered.
entries.title: Stage-0 lambda-E cap drifted from the locked table
entries.what_it_would_take: Retain exact zero Stage-0 lambda-E configuration and schedule-path tests.

entries.rationale: Per-term gradient statistics were absent from the original step path; INST-02 now emits and validates the ten raw/applied norms with completeness provenance.
entries.title: per-term gradient statistics were not logged
entries.what_it_would_take: Keep the complete gradient-statistics emission and missing-statistics refusal tests.

entries.rationale: The source expression left the component reduction implicit; GAP-45-01 option A records the implemented mean-over-nine convention as the accepted L_data contract without rewriting the locked specification.
entries.title: L-data component reduction was underspecified
entries.what_it_would_take: Retain the hand-oracle reduction test and the documented provenance of the owner ruling.

entries.rationale: The earlier suite defended divergent assembly/configuration behavior and lacked boundary tests; TEST-01/02 corrected those expectations and now exercise the real seams.
entries.title: tests encoded or missed the assembly divergences
entries.what_it_would_take: Keep the corrected config and assembly-boundary tests in the maintained regression suite.

entries.rationale: The measured permutation and COM/boost residency divergence was repaired exactly within the owner-approved minimum scope, and the post-repair probe was recorded.
entries.title: resident bodies were not aligned with ordered masses
entries.what_it_would_take: Retain the repaired residency and invariant probe coverage without expanding the repair scope.

entries.rationale: Residency now uses the rotation-gauged, D/V-scaled frame and the validation-frame constant was re-ratified in the same change, closing the training/validation pairing divergence.
entries.title: resident frame stopped before the canonical scaled contract
entries.what_it_would_take: Keep the coherent-frame test and the same-change re-ratification requirement.

entries.rationale: CONF-01 is settled by owner instruction on measured arm evidence, not by a clean VERDICT_TARGETS_ARE_RAW or VERDICT_TARGETS_ARE_SCALED token. This qualification is mandatory wherever CONF-01 is cited under EVAL-01 precondition (ii): RG-02 was settled by measured evidence, not a clean verdict token.
entries.title: CONF-01 carries an owner-ruling qualification
entries.what_it_would_take: Phase 51 must carry this qualification whenever it projects CONF-01 into EVAL-01 precondition (ii).

entries.rationale: The Stage-0 slice deliberately does not build a multi-stage factory; an entered Stage 2 without reconfiguration is refused rather than silently accepted.
entries.title: multi-stage factory remains deferred
entries.what_it_would_take: A future owner-authorized platform phase must implement and verify stage-specific reconfiguration.

entries.rationale: Stochastic L-BFGS for stages 3–6 remains deliberately unbuilt; the typed preflight refusal is the honest Stage-0 boundary.
entries.title: stochastic L-BFGS stages remain deferred
entries.what_it_would_take: A future owner-authorized platform phase must implement the stochastic L-BFGS stages and retire this deferred-scope record.

entries.rationale: The owner selected N = 500 (= 0.5 · N_Adam,0) on 2026-08-05. Invariant B now enforces the owner-ratified front-advance window; any Phase-50 HALT is owner-adjudicated and no agent may adjust N.
entries.title: invariant-B window N is unset
entries.what_it_would_take: Closed by the owner ruling and the enforcing invariant-B trip test; any future re-ruling must be recorded as a new owner decision.

entries.rationale: The source writes I_warm as min(2000, 0.1·N_Adam,k) while a step count must be integral; the implementation floors it, and both readings agree for N_Adam,0 = 1000.
entries.title: I-warm integer floor is an interpretation
entries.what_it_would_take: Carry the interpretation as a charter-level wording question if a non-integral budget is ever owner-selected.

entries.rationale: The Stage-0 collocation budget is hard-coded at 16 rather than config-resolved. The spec treats collocation budgets as provisional/example values, so this is a wiring gap rather than a locked-value departure.
entries.title: collocation count is hard-coded
entries.what_it_would_take: Charter work must decide the general config-vs-locked-table coverage and any future recipe surface.

entries.rationale: The v2.2 band runs the shipped 1000-step Stage-0 budget (stage.max_epochs=1000, stage.n_adam=1000) while the v2.0 'pilot' actually ran the 300-step ACC-02 smoke budget (run.smoke=true) at seeds 41/42/43 -- so any v2.2-vs-v2.0 outcome difference is confounded by more than a 3.33x step-count change: n_adam 300->1000 also moves PHYS-05 I_warm=floor(0.1*n_adam) from 30->100 (first full-physics step 31->101), extends CosineAnnealingLR T_max 300->1000, increases planned validation opportunities 3->10, and the graded configs' un-set stage.replay_count resolves to the DATA-05 default 240 vs the smoke's explicit 32 -- a 7.5x training-batch identity/workload change. This qualification must travel into every Phase-50 run record and into Phase 52's DIAG-05 re-derivation (GAP-44-02); it is not discharged by this phase.
entries.title: v2.2 band runs the 1000-step shipped Stage-0 budget vs the 300-step v2.0 pilot smoke budget
entries.what_it_would_take: a 300-step budget-matched arm (recorded deferred idea) or an owner ruling that the confound is acceptable; otherwise discharged into Phase 52 DIAG-05
